title: Causes of Disease: *miatt*, *emiatt*, *következtében*
grammar: Naming the cause of an infection
goal: I can say what caused an infection with *miatt*, *emiatt* and *következtében*.
I can name the ideas of the study of disease (*kóroktan*, *transzmisszió*, *járványtani vizsgálat*).
I can write one short sentence about the cause of a disease.

sections.title: Unit 27: Disease, Prevention and Medical Ethics
body: This unit is about how a disease is explained and prevented: naming the cause of an infection, describing a measure, setting evidence against an old belief, a doctor's duties, and judging the size of a change.
The unit ends with a text about Semmelweis Ignác and childbed fever in Vienna in 1847.
